result: At pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, RequestMetaObject is a transparent wrapper over the request metadata map and defines the exact SEP-2575 keys io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion and io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities. set_protocol_version inserts the protocol string under the former key and set_client_capabilities serializes ClientCapabilities under the latter. Request serialization reads RequestMetaObject from Extensions through request_meta, passes that raw map into WithMeta, and WithMeta emits one params._meta map containing the merged metadata. JsonRpcRequest serializes its request field with serde(flatten), so the Request method/params serialization, including params._meta, is flattened directly into the JSON-RPC request object alongside jsonrpc and id. This closes the prior in-memory-versus-wire uncertainty for the concrete ordinary post-discover request path at this pinned source revision: the two required keys are source-proven to serialize under JSON-RPC params._meta before transport serialization. No network capture or deployed-server claim is made.
